class.name: SteamTimelineEvent
class.brief_description: Identifies an event created by a Steam Timeline service.
class.description: Pass this handle back to the issuing [SteamTimeline] to update, end, remove, or inspect an event. The handle expires when its owning client scope stops.

method.name: is_open
method.description: Returns whether the handle identifies a valid range awaiting its end time.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether the handle still belongs to an active scope and its event has not been removed.
